# nxos_vtp (Data Source)

This data source can read the VTP (VLAN Trunking Protocol) configuration on NX-OS devices, including domain, mode, version, password and VLAN database file settings.

### API Documentation

- [vtpEntity](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%202/vtp:Entity/)
- [vtpInst](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%202/vtp:Inst/)
- [vtpIntf](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%202/vtp:Intf/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nxos_vtp" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `domain` (String) domain.
- `file_path` (String) file.
- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.
- `instance_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `interfaces` (Attributes Map) List of VTP interfaces.
  - Map key: `interface_id` - Id (eg: eth1/3) of L2 interface which has VTP enabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `mode` (String) mode.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) password.
- `password_wo` (String) The write-only value of the attribute.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) The write-only version of the attribute.
- `version` (Number) version.

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `admin_state` (String) Admin state of L2 interface which has VTP enabled.
